title: GINCLEAR™ Filler Spool
description: Berkley GINCLEAR Fluorocarbon is formulated for maximum smoothness, flexibility, and low memory culminating in a superior casting performance. Use GINCLEAR as your go-to mainline or shock leader when using as a leader with braid. GINCLEAR is level wound for added manageability making every cast as if it’s the first out of the box!
features: Formulated for maximum smoothness, flexibility, and low memory culminating in a superior casting performance
Ideal as your go-to mainline fluorocarbon OR use as a shock leader when tying to braid
Level wound for added manageability making every cast as if it’s the first out of the box!
